# Fix Customer Service

> Customer service operations help from Abdullah Khan, based in Dubai and working with businesses anywhere. Thirteen years running support functions, the last seven building and leading the customer service department at a fintech in Dubai. The work is practical: faster replies, lower cost per contact, fewer repeat questions, better reviews, and a team setup that absorbs growth without linear hiring.

## Pages

- [Home](https://fixcustomerservice.com/): the full offer, what poor customer service costs, two case studies with tracked numbers, the eight KPIs that get measured, and how an engagement runs
- [Privacy policy](https://fixcustomerservice.com/privacy): what happens to information sent through the site
- [Sitemap](https://fixcustomerservice.com/sitemap.xml): every indexable page

## What is offered

- [Free 30-minute call](https://fixcustomerservice.com/#talk): an honest read on the three biggest problems in a business's customer service, with no obligation
- [The one-week look](https://fixcustomerservice.com/#how): counting what comes in, what gets answered, how long it takes and what it costs, delivered as a short plain report
- [The fix](https://fixcustomerservice.com/#how): shared inbox, automated answers to repeat questions, reply-time targets, complaint handling, team structure and training
- [Cost calculator](https://fixcustomerservice.com/#cost): a browser-side estimate of unanswered enquiries and their annual value

## Evidence

- [Case studies](https://fixcustomerservice.com/#proof): 96% lower wait time and 69% of chats resolved without an agent on one rebuild; 45% fewer incoming requests, first response SLA from 75% to 98%, and a 30% smaller team on another
- [Infobip customer story](https://www.infobip.com/customer/edenred): third-party published account of the WhatsApp rebuild, naming Abdullah Khan as customer service lead
- [LinkedIn profile](https://www.linkedin.com/in/abdullahkhan08/): full career history

## Optional

- [Who it is for](https://fixcustomerservice.com/#proof): any industry, from a few hundred to hundreds of thousands of customer messages a month
- [Data handling](https://fixcustomerservice.com/#talk): NDA before anything is shared, read-only access where possible, no customer data taken off client systems

## Writing

- [Reply time is not the real problem](https://fixcustomerservice.com/blog/reply-time-is-not-the-real-problem): Faster replies fix the symptom. Look at contact rate and first contact resolution first, or you will pay to answer messages you should never receive.
- [How to calculate cost per contact](https://fixcustomerservice.com/blog/how-to-calculate-cost-per-contact): Work out what each customer message really costs you, using figures you already have. No new tooling, about twenty minutes.
